sections.title: Section 22 of the Bangladesh Hi-Tech Park Authority Act, 2010 (Act No. 8 of 2010) from 2019 to June 30, 2024 (both days inclusive), if any money is in
sections.content_text: Section 22 of the Bangladesh Hi-Tech Park Authority Act, 2010 (Act No. 8 of 2010) from 2019 to June 30, 2024 (both days inclusive), if any money is invested in the construction of any industrial establishment engaged in the production of any goods or services, no question shall be raised as to the source of such invested money, 10% (ten percent) on invested before filing the return for the relevant income year is filed is paid.
